title: LQ Digital Mode Family Golden Test Vectors Suite
author: Luis Quesada (HB9IPH) <luis@lq8.org>
description: Comprehensive golden test vector suite containing canonical conversions, 77-bit Huffman bitfields, CRC-14 checksums, LDPC(174,91) codewords, and mode-specific physical channel tone sequences across all 4 modes (LQ8, LQ16, LQ4, LQ2).
